title: Journey through our Solar System – B1+ English Listening Test

seo.title: Journey through our Solar System – B1+ English Listening Test - Test-English
seo.description: Boost your English listening skills with our upper-intermediate comprehension test on space. Instant feedback and transcript are included!

parts:
B1+ English Listening Test

Watch a video about the Solar System, and for questions 1 to 8, choose the correct answer.
See the full list of B1+ listening tests
Questions

questions.prompt: What does the video discuss about the Sun?

choices.html: distance
volume
diameter
It takes 176 days for Mercury to travel around the Sun.
It has longer days than nights.
It cannot preserve heat after sunset.

questions.prompt: What can we deduce from the video’s words about Venus?

choices.html: It serves as a warning about human actions.
It has a similar atmosphere to Earth.
It may have hosted life in the past.

questions.prompt: What does the video say about Jupiter’s Red Spot?

choices.html: It was thought to be a giant volcano.
It was caused by a collision hundreds of years ago.
It’s a weather phenomenon.
Titan
Ganymede
Mercury

questions.prompt: What is true about Saturn according to the video?

choices.html: It’s the largest planet in our solar system.
It’s the second planet with more moons.
Its number of known moons changes regularly.

questions.prompt: According to the video, what makes Neptune similar to Uranus?

choices.html: Its distance from the Sun.
Its colour.
Its atmospheric conditions.
size
weight
distance to Earth relative to the Sun and Earth’s moon.
